lines.label: PTAC exterior louver / architectural wall grille at the window wall
lines.where: Exterior face of the PTAC sleeve, visible from outside and from the room through the unit's outdoor section.
lines.src: M201 PTAC notes · M501 det.9 · M401 KN1 · A200 keyed note 8 (= AS105 kn 8) · AS103 · size ref 'A-601' (not in the issued set)
lines.instanceNote: FIVE STATEMENTS, NO RESOLUTION. M201: 'polypropylene louver kit (color by architect)'. M501 det.9: 'aluminum architectural-style grille factory-painted to match exterior wall'. M401 KN1: 'furnished with unit; painted to match exterior wall'. A200 kn 8: 'ALUMINUM FIXED WINDOW … WITH INTEGRAL ALUMINUM LOUVER AT PTAC UNITS' — i.e. the glazing sub's buy, not a PTAC accessory. AS103: 'integral louver to be installed with window system'. Disagreement spans MATERIAL, FINISH METHOD and WHICH SUB BUYS IT — and polypropylene is moulded in colour so M201's product and M401's paint instruction may be physically incompatible. Compounding: the size reference A-601 does not exist in the issued set (set has A600 Doors, A610 Windows) — RFI R-04. SETTLES IT: one RFI to MWT / the M-EOR on material, finish, colour and scope, plus the A601→A610 correction. Record what is installed; do not write it up as wrong yet.
lines.verifyAtPunch: From outside — louver present, seated, fastened, blades straight, colour matching the elevation run; from inside — no daylight, no staining. Record the material actually installed.

lines.label: Interior architectural wall grille at the PTAC, painted to match the INTERIOR wall (M401 KN5)

critic.summary: This is a strong list and I could not break it on the things that usually break these. Every equipment model, capacity and dimension I checked is verbatim-correct against the sheet — AZ65H12DAB / 449-300 CFM / 45.0 OSA / 11,900-10,400 / 208-1-60 (M201), min 3-1/4\" AFF + drain kit + caulked sleeve (M501 det 9), Ruskin CFD4 / UL 555C / ceramic shroud / 3\"x3\" angle / no flex (M501 det 2), MERV 13 or 8 (M201), 4\" main condensate + 1\" air gap + Type M copper (P501 det 13, P301, P102), 18\"x18\" access panel in a suspended ceiling with GV+union at three risers (P502 det 3, P401), Sioux Chief 695 vs PPP SMP-500-115V (P102 vs P104), FP-1's \"VK430 7/16 FR 155 C PD\" 62/437, FA-1's 121/121 and SCWLED 80 and SKFIRECOW 3, A120-A123 GN I semi-recessed. Nothing is invented. The M305 arithmetic is exactly right (2,450 CFM = 49 inlets; EF-8/9/11 short by 850 aggregate, EF-10/EV-6 balances). Marks are carried as printed and not normalised — PTAC-2/PTAC-1 correctly confined to the QQ rooms (M301 puts PTAC-1 at all 16 first-floor keys; M401 shows PTAC-2 only on details 01/02), SH-1/SH-3, L-2/L-3/L-4, WC-3/WC-4 all dual-carried. I found no rough-in leaks: the ~24 dropped rows are correctly dropped and every emitted line lands on a visible test point. Room-type discipline is clean — no standard-room item survived (no HD-05 bowed rod on the roll-in side, no strobes, no doorbell, all correctly qty 0), and the accessible-only items are all present. No verify step is a \"verify installed\" no-op. Where it fails is narrower and sharper. Three critical items: it declares that no sheet states a guestroom water-closet seat height and tells the walker not to record one — G400 detail 07 prints 17\"-19\" for TA-15/TA-16 in a schedule titled PRIVATE BATH & PUBLIC RESTROOM, and the same line silently resolves A532's 17\" MIN / 19\" MAX as side clearance rather than carrying both readings; it asserts the accessible-vanity pipe wrap is required by exactly one sheet with zero other hits, when G400 detail 06 prints \"WRAP EXPOSED HOT WATER PIPES AND DRAIN W/ PROTECTIVE PIPE COVER\" and G400 carries the same TA 24/TA 25 rows (it inherited coordination_issues C-09's stale search rather than going past it); and it misses a live, punch-testable contradiction between M201 EF-1 remark 3 (\"switch w/ room lights\") and G402 bath general note 3 (\"FAN TO BE SWITCHED SEPARATELY FROM LIGHT\") — it even cites G402 GN3, but on the entry/closet lighting line where it does nothing. Two visible kitchenette devices are missing (the under-sink dishwasher switch, and the dedicated appliance receptacles). Two lines are over-confident: both switch lines are HIGH on a height the set contests three ways and the third value, G400's 3'-10\", appears nowhere in the list. Two citations import from the wrong row or the wrong sheet: R22000-WS is lifted off P104's SH-1 employee shower onto the guestroom valve (the same error the line warns about for 2.5 GPM), and E201 — the second-floor plan — is cited twice for a first-floor room when E200 expressly defers guestrooms to E400. The WAG-30 line treats A552.md's untranscribed elevations as verified-empty, and the kn50 line mis-states CR-2, which actually books that outlet to 217/317/417 and not to 118. Fix those and it ships.
